sections.name: decision
sections.body: Centralize map overlay registration around Google Maps overlay instances. Keep Google Maps as the base renderer, keep first-party transit as the current layer, and add scenario proposal groups as Google Maps polylines and markers managed by a shared registry.

sections.name: scope
sections.body: Add overlay definitions, visibility state, renderer lifecycle, sample proposal overlays, focused tests, and architecture notes. Do not replace the current GoogleMap surface, routing services, or proposal data schema.

sections.name: contracts
sections.body: Each overlay declares id, label, scenario kind, deterministic render order, default visibility, and a Google Maps factory that returns setVisible and dispose lifecycle hooks.

sections.name: performance
sections.body: Initial proposal overlays are small local examples. Large LA-wide geometry sets should be chunked by layer group, simplified before rendering, gated by min and max zoom, and moved to Data layer or viewport-aware loading before adding thousands of polylines or station markers.

sections.name: decision
sections.body: Extend the VR-001 proposal contract with explicit classification and uncertainty metadata so unofficial concepts cannot be rendered or described as approved future projects.

sections.name: scope
sections.body: Add classification types, validation rules, seed data updates, architecture documentation, and focused validation tests. Keep operational routing and Google Maps rendering contracts unchanged.

sections.name: layer-boundary
sections.body: Official future projects stay in the future layer with classification official. Commentary-summary, advocacy-derived, and speculative records must use visionary scenario treatment and must carry source notes, uncertainty, and disclaimer language.

sections.name: decision:Build the import pipeline as a thin layer over the VR-001 TransitProposalDataset schema. Versioned source files must declare schemaVersion 1.0.0, validate through the shared proposal validator, and emit Google Maps-ready polyline and marker bundles through the existing adapter helpers.

scope:Add import helpers, validation hardening for ids/provenance/versioned datasets, focused tests, and source/provenance documentation. Do not migrate operational TRANSIT_LINES, change routing, add another map provider, or require map components to change for each new proposal record.
